pages.text: Biomes: Plains, Savannahs, Jungles $(br)Diet: Raw Chicken, Raw Rabbit, Boiled Egg, Raw Rat (Rats Mod)

Ball pythons ($(o)Python regius$()), or royal pythons, are medium-sized pythons endemic to central Africa. They are opportunistic hunters with different diets based on sex: females appear to prefer a fossorial lifestyle and rodent diet, while males are more prone to climb and feed on birds. Adults reach lengths of 3-5 feet and around 1,500 grams, with females being slightly larger on average. When threatened, ball pythons curl themselves into a tight ball to protect their head.
